racial.name: Momentum Affinity
racial.detail: Increased resistance to movement-restricting effects. Movement abilities have increased effect. Attacks made while moving deal increased damage. Does not add raw speed.

racial.name: Unknown Variable
racial.detail: Language adaptation. Can absorb essences, awakening stones, and skill books. Immune to identification and tracking.

log.title: Field assessment
log.detail: Rode out with Vincent Trenslow's group. Killed a rune tortoise with Comet Strike and a knife and passed. Used Moonwell for two village kids. Night watch with Vincent; a village dog gave Nate a fish. Watched Jason kill the bark lurker; volunteered to scout trap weavers but the right answer was no one. Pie with Jason and Humphrey at the pond-town lodge; the stasis breakfast came out still warm.

log.title: Iron rank
log.detail: Claimed the Comet confluence on the hotel roof garden (Lightning + Star + Wind; bonded to Spirit, awakened Comet Strike) and reached iron rank. Purged and passed out. Used the Awakening Stone of the Undertow (Moonwell, on Star), then tested Moonwell, Comet Strike, and Windward Veil with Rufus, Farrah, and Gary.

log.title: The Sunken Shrine
log.detail: Two hours south along the coast with Rufus, Farrah, and Gary (Varrow estate contract). Killed the rock crabs on the shelf and cleared the shrine; The Final Piece complete (an essence plus coin). Wind absorbed (bonded to Recovery, awakened Windward Veil).

log.title: Under the Old City
log.detail: Tannery culvert pipe beasts, the cistern nest with Gary, the flooded-tunnel eel, and Warehouse Pests. Found Tomas Reeve's drowned map, key, note, and ledger.

log.title: The Vault
log.detail: With Rufus, Farrah, and Gary: Farrah broke the ward, killed the stone centipede, claimed the Star Essence from the magic pool, and absorbed it back at the suite (bonded to Power, awakened Star Mark).

log.title: Night in Old City
log.detail: Took the Cellar Dwellers job, killed two ratlings, ran home testing momentum, and crashed in room 32.

log.title: Greenstone
log.detail: 1 iron Island permit, tracking stone touched. Room 32 at Sailor's Watch for 2 nights. Registered at the Adventure Society with Albert; intake tomorrow morning. Window-shopped essences.

log.title: Barge and delta
log.detail: Sailed all night, meditating. Pitched the momentum hammer to Gary. Jason left at the delta; Nate stayed with the team.

log.title: Verdant Fields
log.detail: Hostel night, Floorboard Feeders filler, compass pointed upstream.

log.title: The road
log.detail: Fruit wagon, walled town cottage, Cascade rolled, flower brothers, earth elemental lesson.

missions.name: Eyes and Aura
missions.detail: Objectives: acquire an awakening stone suited to a perception power 0/1; acquire an awakening stone suited to an aura power 0/1. Reward: 200 iron spirit coins. Bonus objective: awaken a perception power and an aura power 0/2. Bonus reward: 1 common awakening stone. Leads: Awakening Stone of Eyes (common; brokers Ostrander & Vey, trade hall 3rd floor, or auction); aura stones are rarer (auction or tougher monsters).

abilities.name: Arc Step
abilities.detail: Dissolve into a streak of lightning and reappear a short distance away along a line of sight. Anything in the path takes a jolt of lightning damage. Cost: Low mana (5%). Cooldown: 5 seconds. Cannot carry passengers.

abilities.name: Star Mark
abilities.detail: Mark a target you can see with a point of starlight only you can perceive. You always know the marked target's direction and distance (felt, not seen). One target at a time. Low mana, no cooldown. Passes through walls and floors. Tested range: about 3,300 feet (0.6 miles) at Iron 0, fading near the edge. Cost: 2% mana per mark; no upkeep, no cooldown.

abilities.name: Windward Veil
abilities.detail: A shell of swirling wind wraps around you, deflecting projectiles and blunting incoming blows. Stronger while you are moving. Cost: Low mana (5%) to raise, then 1% mana per minute while active.

abilities.name: Comet Strike
abilities.detail: Your weapon or fist ignites with a white-gold comet trail. The strike hits harder the more you moved just before it and leaves a burning wound that deals damage over time. Cost: Moderate mana (10%) + 5% stamina per strike. Cooldown 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Moonwell
abilities.detail: Conjure a pool of starlit water on the ground for 1 minute. Allies in it regain 2% health, 2% stamina, and 1% mana every few seconds (about 20% health and stamina over the full minute) and minor afflictions are washed away. Cost: 30% mana. Cooldown 10 minutes. From the Awakening Stone of the Undertow.

abilities.name: Sky Stair
abilities.detail: Wind (from Awakening Stone of the Sky). Special ability (movement). Cost: Low mana (3%). Cooldown: 5 seconds. For 5 seconds, the air beneath your feet becomes solid footing for up to 3 steps; each step can launch you up or forward like pushing off ground. Counts as movement for Momentum Affinity and Comet Strike. On the recorded wind flight-ability list: more steps at bronze, continuous air-walking (flight) at silver.

essenceNotes.name: Comet
essenceNotes.detail: Confluence of Lightning + Star + Wind (invented, non-canon; locked). Streaking high-speed movement, burning trails, impact landings. Claimed on the roof garden; Nate reached iron rank.

essenceNotes.name: Still needed
